info.name: Fuel Route Planner API
info.description: Collection for testing the Fuel Route Planner API endpoints, covering place names, coordinates, short trips, invalid locations, and outside-USA locations.

request.description: Calculates optimal fuel stops between two US city names (New York, NY to Los Angeles, CA).

response.name: 1. Route by Place Names (Long Trip) - Response (200 OK)

request.description: Calculates optimal route using lat/long coordinate objects (Chicago, IL to Dallas, TX).
Short route under 500 miles (New York, NY to Philadelphia, PA) where starting tank is sufficient.

response.name: 3. Short Trip (No Refueling Stops) - Response (200 OK)

request.description: Request with an unresolvable place name returning HTTP 400 and INVALID_LOCATION code.
Request with a location outside the contiguous United States (Honolulu, HI) returning HTTP 400 and OUTSIDE_CONTIGUOUS_US code.

response.name: 5. Outside Contiguous USA Location - Response (400 Bad Request)
